newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CAM International unit gets IBM contract.
newsitem.headline: CAM International unit gets IBM contract.

text.p: CAM International Holdings Ltd (CAM) subsidiary CAM Advanced Technologies (CTM) has signed a contract with IBM storage systems division to assemble magnetoresistive head stacks, CAM said on Thursday.
The precision engineering group said in a statement that the new contract would double CTM's existing business with IBM storage in the next two years.

CTM is setting aside 30,000 sq feet of production floor space for the new contract and anticipates it will increase total workforce at its Prai, Malaysia plant from 1,000 to 3,000 over the next two years.
The contract is not expected to have any material impact on earnings or net assets per share in the current financial year ending September 30, 1997, the statement said.
